blueprints.name: noise_opening_cant_hear_name
blueprints.description: User cannot hear agent's name clearly at call start due to bad signal
behavior_steps: User picks up and says 'Hello? Hello? Kaun bol raha hai?'
User says they cannot hear the agent's name clearly
Agent repeats only name and identity slowly
User confirms and agrees to continue
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent repeats only name and ministry clearly and then reconfirms user identity
failure_indicators: Agent proceeds to survey without identity confirmation

blueprints.name: noise_opening_cant_hear_ministry
blueprints.description: User cannot hear which ministry the agent is calling from
behavior_steps: User answers call with background noise
User says 'Ministry? Kaunsi ministry? Samajh nahi aaya'
Agent repeats only Ministry of Agriculture, Government of India
Agent proceeds with confirmation of farmer identity
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent clarifies ministry once without repeating full greeting
failure_indicators: Agent ignores confusion and moves ahead

blueprints.name: noise_opening_background_static
blueprints.description: Heavy background static and traffic noise from beginning
behavior_steps: User picks up with traffic noise
User says 'Awaaz bahut kat rahi hai'
Agent checks audio issue and speaks slowly
User asks to repeat purpose briefly
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent acknowledges noise and repeats only missed information
failure_indicators: Agent does not check for audio clarity

blueprints.name: noise_slot_cant_hear_survey_number
blueprints.description: User cannot hear the survey number clearly
behavior_steps: Call starts smoothly and identity is confirmed
Agent repeats only survey number and village
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent repeats only the survey number context

blueprints.name: noise_slot_cant_hear_crop_name
blueprints.description: User cannot hear the crop name clearly
behavior_steps: Agent asks if Magfali crop is correct
User says 'Mag... kya bola? Samajh nahi aaya'
Agent repeats only crop name clearly
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent repeats crop name slowly and clearly

blueprints.name: noise_slot_signal_drops_mid_sentence
blueprints.description: Signal drops mid-sentence while explaining survey context
behavior_steps: Signal drops and user misses half sentence
User says 'Ruk ruk, kya bola abhi?'
Agent resumes from last incomplete sentence
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent resumes from last incomplete point only

blueprints.name: interruption_return_short_pause
blueprints.description: User has a brief interruption and returns
behavior_steps: User returns saying 'Haan ji, kya bol rahe the?'
Agent resumes from same survey question
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent resumes last unanswered question

blueprints.name: interruption_return_long_pause_forgets_context
blueprints.description: User returns after long interruption and forgets context
behavior_steps: User leaves due to another call
User returns saying 'Hum kya discuss kar rahe the?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent gives brief context and resumes correct survey

blueprints.name: interruption_return_multiple_mini_interruptions
blueprints.description: User has multiple short interruptions
behavior_steps: User interrupts twice due to surroundings
User asks 'Abhi kis survey pe hain?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent maintains state and clarifies current survey
failure_indicators: Agent loses track of survey order

blueprints.name: partial_confirmation_confirms_crop_asks_name
blueprints.description: User confirms crop but asks agent name mid-answer
behavior_steps: User says 'Haan sahi hai, waise aapka naam kya tha?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent answers tangent and returns to task

blueprints.name: partial_confirmation_confirms_survey_asks_data_source
blueprints.description: User confirms survey but asks where data came from
behavior_steps: User says 'Haan sahi hai, par data kahan se aaya?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent answers and smoothly returns to flow

blueprints.name: partial_confirmation_mid_confirmation_topic_switch
blueprints.description: User switches topic mid-confirmation
behavior_steps: User starts confirming then asks about purpose again
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent redirects politely and repeats question

blueprints.name: confusion_doesnt_understand_verify
blueprints.description: User does not understand what verify means
behavior_steps: Agent explains in simple terms once
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent explains simply without repetition

blueprints.name: confusion_doesnt_understand_purpose
blueprints.description: User repeatedly asks purpose of call
behavior_steps: Agent redirects and repeats last survey question
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent follows rule of two explanations then redirects

blueprints.name: confusion_suspicious_asks_proof
blueprints.description: User is suspicious and asks for proof
behavior_steps: User asks 'Aap sach mein government se ho?'
Agent calmly explains government verification call
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent reassures without becoming defensive

blueprints.name: confusion_elderly_user
blueprints.description: Elderly user struggles to understand process
behavior_steps: User says 'Beta, samajh nahi aa raha'
Agent slows down and simplifies explanation
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent adapts tone and speed

blueprints.name: repeated_perturbation_two_noise_issues
blueprints.description: User faces two separate noise issues
behavior_steps: User reports poor signal at start
Later user again says 'Awaaz nahi aa rahi'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent offers callback after repeated issues

blueprints.name: repeated_perturbation_noise_and_interruption
blueprints.description: Combination of noise and interruption
behavior_steps: User has noise issue during first survey
Later user is interrupted by another person
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent identifies repeated disruption and offers callback

blueprints.name: repeated_perturbation_escalating_frustration
blueprints.description: User becomes frustrated due to repeated signal problems
behavior_steps: Agent offers callback at convenient time
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent de-escalates and offers callback

blueprints.name: repeated_perturbation_three_signal_drops
blueprints.description: Three signal drops throughout the call
behavior_steps: Drops third time during second survey
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent proactively offers callback after repeated drops
failure_indicators: Agent fails to end call gracefully
